en.basel-kadem: 1.	We were told by my father, may Allah grant him mercy, that he said: We were told by Abdullah bin Ja’far al-Himyari, from Harun ibn Muslim, from Mas’ada bin Sadaqa, from Ja’far bin Muhammed, from his father, from his fathers, peace be upon them,

that he said: The Prophet, Allah’s blessings be upon him and his Family, said: I entered Paradise, and then I saw that most of its people were stupid. He said: I said: What is the stupid? So he said: The rational in good things, the unaware in evil things, who fasts, in every month, three days.
